unit_label: BRBL::MOD_C::U11: Apply the stated monetary threshold without confusing debt definition and forum eligibility

facts.statement: Book identifies notified20lakh threshold from6September2018; debt includes interest and secured/unsecured claims. Its15lakh end-question answer conflicts with threshold; excluded from reuse. Multistate banks differ from blanket cooperative-bank exclusion.

payload.title: A debt can exist while the chosen recovery route is unavailable
payload.core_explanation_md:
The courseware identifies a notified INR 20 lakh threshold for this recovery route, including principal and interest in the claim analysis. Whether an amount is legally a debt is a different question from whether the application meets the forum threshold. An unsecured claim is not disqualified merely because no mortgage exists.

Applicant status also matters. The source separately discusses multi-State cooperative banks after its broader historical cooperative-bank discussion; a blanket exclusion misses that distinction. Its conflicting smaller-value end-question answer is not used here. Threshold, institution class, jurisdiction and date must each be established before a live filing.

self_check.prompt_text: Does proving a legally recoverable debt alone establish every forum condition?
self_check.expected_takeaway: No. Threshold, applicant category and jurisdiction remain separate.

payload.stem_md: For a hypothetical exercise expressly using an INR 20 lakh threshold, a claim totals INR 18 lakh including interest. What is the defensible distinction?

options.text_md: No legal debt can exist below the forum threshold
options.explanation_md: The threshold does not erase the underlying obligation.

options.text_md: Being secured automatically removes the threshold
options.explanation_md: Security alone is not the stated threshold exception.

options.text_md: The source smaller-value answer overrides the stated rule without explanation
options.explanation_md: An inconsistent key is not a sound basis for the assessment.

options.text_md: The debt may exist while this stated forum threshold is not met
options.explanation_md: Debt existence and route eligibility answer different questions.

payload.correct_explanation_md: Debt existence and route eligibility answer different questions.

payload.stem_md: A lender classifies every cooperative bank identically despite the source separate multi-State category. What should the legal mapping examine?

options.explanation_md: Trade name does not establish the statutory category.

options.text_md: The exact institutional category and applicable inclusion or alternative recovery route
options.explanation_md: The source distinguishes categories and statutory routes.

options.text_md: Whether the customer prefers a Tribunal
options.explanation_md: Borrower preference does not define the applicant class.

options.text_md: The size of the nearest branch
options.explanation_md: Branch size is not a legal category.

payload.correct_explanation_md: The source distinguishes categories and statutory routes.
